cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.85%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -0.92%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +16.45%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +16.45%, BE +9.44%, TLN +9.18%, ENPH +8.38%, GEV +6.57%. Laggards: MPLX -2.34%, FANG -2.25%, APA -1.62%, COP -1.59%.
